# Reaper-MCP Full Reference

FastMCP server for Reaper DAW automation via OSC and reapy-boost. Provides project management, track/transport control, crosslink orchestration, and ReaScript execution.

## Architecture

```
Claude / Cursor ← MCP stdio → Reaper MCP Server ← OSC UDP → Reaper DAW
                                  ↓
                          FastAPI + MCP HTTP (/mcp)
                                  ↓
                          Vite React dashboard (port 10796)
```

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend (FastAPI + MCP HTTP `/mcp`) | 10797 |
| Frontend (Vite React) | 10796 |
| OSC → Reaper (UDP) | 8000 |

## MCP Tools

### `reaper_transport`

Playback control. Operations: play, stop, pause, record, position, status.

### `reaper_tracks`

Track management. Operations: list, info, mute, solo, arm, count, bulk.

### `reaper_project`

Project operations. Operations: info, save, marker, render, stats.

### `reaper_system`

System status. Operations: status, help, capabilities.

### `reaper_reascript`

ReaScript execution. Operations: run, setup, api_help.

### `reaper_orchestrator`

SG2-to-mix workflow automation. Operations: stem_import, fx_chain, regions, full_pipeline.

## REST API

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/health` | GET | Health check |
| `/api/v1/tools` | GET | List MCP tools |
| `/api/v1/tools/{name}` | POST | Call MCP tool |
| `/mcp` | Various | Streamable HTTP MCP transport |

## Configuration

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `OSC_HOST` | OSC listen address | `127.0.0.1` |
| `OSC_PORT` | OSC UDP port | `8000` |
| `REAPER_TOOL_MODE` | portmanteau or individual | `portmanteau` |
| `REAPER_PATH` | Reaper executable path | (optional) |

## Known Issues

- Requires Reaper DAW running with OSC control surface enabled
- Share directory for prompts: `prompts/`
- Tool mode can be toggled via `REAPER_TOOL_MODE` env var
